application.description: Connect to an MQTT broker and trigger flows when messages are published to subscribed topics. Each connection targets one broker (set the broker URL on the connection); flows subscribe to topics via the New Message event.

auth_config.description: Username/password authentication for the MQTT broker. The user must have permission to SUBSCRIBE (read) on the topics you want to trigger from.
auth_config.credential_help_text: Broker username/password. The user must be allowed to subscribe (read) to the topics you want to trigger from.

events.description: Fires every time a message is published to a subscribed MQTT topic. The listener holds a persistent connection to the broker; the broker pushes messages in real time (no polling).

event_configuration.description: Defaults for the subscription. Override per connection (subscription_config) or per flow (trigger config). Subscription keys: mqtt_topic_filter / mqtt_qos / mqtt_payload_format. Performance & Delivery keys (same names at every level): mqtt_batch_size (1 = no batching; >1 delivers variables.messages + variables.message_count), mqtt_batch_window_seconds (flush a partial batch after this window), mqtt_max_rate (max executions/sec, 0 = unlimited), mqtt_rate_overflow (fold excess into next batch | drop), mqtt_max_concurrent (per-flow concurrent execution cap, 0 = global pool only), mqtt_dedup (off | payload | key), mqtt_dedup_key (template like {{payload.device_id}}:{{payload.seq}}), mqtt_dedup_window_seconds (dedup lock TTL).

topic.description: Topic the message was published to

payload.description: Decoded payload (parsed object when payload_format is json, otherwise string)

payload_raw.description: Raw payload string exactly as received

qos.description: QoS level of the received message (0/1/2)

retain.description: Whether the message was a retained message

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the message was received

messages.description: Only present when mqtt_batch_size > 1: all messages in the batch (each with topic/payload/payload_raw/qos/retain/timestamp). topic/payload keep pointing at the first message for backward compatibility.

message_count.description: Only present when mqtt_batch_size > 1: number of messages in the batch

metadata.notes: Broker URL format: mqtt://host:1883 (plaintext) or mqtts://host:8883 (TLS). Set per connection via subscription_config.base_url; falls back to the application base_url.
